lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a wider, less structured grid pattern along the posterior mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a geometric grid of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow immediately ventral to the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced-out spots on the primary trunk.
